thread:
maria: FYI CloudPSP opened a dispute: Feb GCP marketplace payout looks wrong. They attached their payout CSV and our invoice. They claim a $48 shortfall. Can someone triage? :grimacing:
ashok: On it. Maria, paste the invoice line + partner CSV rows they attached.
maria: Invoice snippet copied here:
```
INV: INV-2026-02-3220
SKU: redwood_dedicated_small
Qty: 200
List unit price: $1.00
Committed discount (20%): net $0.80
Line net: $160.00
```
Partner payout CSV (as received from reseller):
```
sku,units,unit_price_paid,fees
redwood_dedicated_small,200,0.80,24.00
```
maria: Partner says GCP paid them $0.80/unit but after platform fees they received $136; they expected $176 (their margin expectations make the dispute confusing).
james: billing-bot, which pricing profile did the marketplace exporter use for merchant=cloudpsp on 2026-02-28?
billing-bot: export finished for merchant=cloudpsp at 2026-02-28T23:58Z. Pricing profile applied: PROFILE_LEGACY_PUBLIC.\ashok: That's the issue. The merchant has a committed discount (PROFILE_COMMITTED_20) on our side but the exporter used a legacy public profile. Likely due to SKU aliasing after our Jan SKU rename.
sophie: I contacted GCP partner support (ticket GP-88512). They confirm the metering rows matched our legacy alias redwood_small_legacy which in their mapping is not linked to the committed price. They suggested updating SKU alias mapping in the partner console.\ames: (typo) James: We did rename skus in Jan. Did we propagate alias mapping to GCP?\maria: We updated the canonical SKU but apparently missed mapping the legacy alias to the committed price profile in the marketplace connector.
ashok: Action plan: 1) issue a one-time credit memo to CloudPSP for Feb to cover the delta 2) update GCP SKU alias mapping so future exports pick committed profile 3) add exporter test to prevent fallback to public profile when merchant has a commit. Who owns each?
james: I'll own exporter fix + PR. Will add an integration test that simulates legacy alias fall-through. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
maria: Finance: need calculation for the credit memo. Partner reports $48 shortfall. Can someone validate?
james: Quick reconciliation: if partner expected to receive 200 * (0.80 + partner_margin) = 200 * 0.88 = 176 -> but actual net after fees was 136 -> delta = 40. Their reported $48 might include assumed fees. Need partner spreadsheet.
maria: Partner provided their margin file:
```
sku,units,partner_margin_pct,expected_net
redwood_dedicated_small,200,10,176.0
```
maria: They say actual payout after GCP fee = 136. So shortfall = 40. But they attached another line showing an extra platform fee of $8, so total claimed shortfall = 48.
kelly: AP here. To approve a credit memo we need: invoice id, computed delta, supporting exports, and the GCP ticket. Please attach the billing export link and the partner email thread.
maria: Attaching links: s3://redwood-billing/gcp/reconciliations/2026-02/cloudpsp-diff-1799510123.csv and internal export https://internal.redwood/billing/exports/1799510123 (md5:9e107d9d372bb6826bd81d3542a419d6). Ticket GP-88512.
ashok: Recommend issuing CM-2026-02-005 for $48 to cover partner claim while we finish audit; treat as provisional and reserve right to adjust if reconciliation shows different. Finance/Legal ok with provisional credit?
maria: Approving provisional credit pending audit. kelly, please raise CM-2026-02-005 for $48 to CloudPSP, reference INV-2026-02-3220 and ticket GP-88512. Include note: provisional marketplace adjustment pending final reconciliation.
kelly: Approved. I'll create the credit memo and route for signature. Expect it posted in 2 business days.\sophie: I'll keep partner updated: told them we'll issue provisional $48 credit and follow up once internal reconciliation completes.
james: I'll submit PR to marketplace-connector today to attach committed profile to legacy aliases and add exporter check.
ashok: Also schedule a short postmortem with product and engineering to ensure SKU renames get full mapping updates.
maria: Thanks team. Leaving thread open until CM posted and PR merged. :thumbsup:
